```{=html}
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .55rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
  text-align: right;
}

.outcome-evidence-group .effect-bar-stack {
  margin-top: .55rem;
  padding-top: .9rem;
  padding-bottom: .8rem;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .outcome-evidence-group-header {
    display: block;
  }

  .outcome-evidence-group-meta {
    margin-top: .16rem;
    text-align: left;
  }
}

.outcome-metric-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .38rem;
  margin-top: .58rem;
}

.outcome-metric-chip {
  min-width: 105px;
  padding: .42rem .5rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
}

.outcome-metric-chip-label {
  color: #7b8798;
  font-size: .52rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 790;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}

.outcome-metric-chip-value {
  margin-top: .14rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .72rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 880;
}

.outcome-metric-chip-note {
  margin-top: .13rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .5rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.beta-evidence-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .42rem;
  margin-top: .58rem;
}

.beta-evidence-item {
  padding: .5rem .55rem;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
}

.beta-evidence-value {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 880;
}

.beta-evidence-shift {
  margin-top: .14rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .58rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.beta-evidence-source {
  margin-top: .16rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .5rem;
}

.published-contrast-details {
  margin-top: .58rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed #d7dee8;
}

.published-contrast-details > summary {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .59rem;
  font-weight: 790;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.published-contrast-list {
  margin: .42rem 0 0 1rem;
  padding: 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .57rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .beta-evidence-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.effect-bar-stack {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1.45rem 0 1.55rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce3eb;
}

.effect-bar-panel {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.effect-bar-panel + .effect-bar-panel {
  margin-top: 1.55rem;
  padding-top: 1.55rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce3eb;
}

.effect-bar-panel.unavailable {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.effect-bar-topline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
}

.effect-bar-label {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .92rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: normal;
}

.effect-bar-value {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: right;
}

.effect-bar-caption {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  margin-top: .32rem;
}

.effect-distribution {
  margin: 0;
}

.effect-distribution-track {
  position: relative;
  height: 13px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: visible;
  margin-top: .65rem;
  margin-bottom: .75rem;
}

.effect-distribution-axis {
  display: none;
}

.effect-distribution-centerfill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.effect-distribution-zero {
  position: absolute;
  top: -5px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 23px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #6b7280;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 4;
}

.effect-distribution-range {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  height: 5px;
  background: #6b7280;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 3;
}


.effect-distribution-range.fill-increased {
  background: var(--risk-increased);
}

.effect-distribution-range.fill-lowered {
  background: var(--risk-lowered);
}

.effect-distribution-iqr {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px;
  height: 21px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .25);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .66);
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .20);
  z-index: 2;
}

/* 3+ effect models: use the colored observed-range line as the skinny baseline and place the thicker IQR band over it. */
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model {
  height: 34px;
  background: transparent;
  margin-top: .35rem;
  margin-bottom: .15rem;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-axis {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 0;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-centerfill {
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-range {
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-iqr {
  top: 3px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-zero {
  top: 6px;
  height: 22px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .legend-snpster-diamond-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 4px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .86);
  border: 1px solid rgba(17, 24, 39, .20);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10);
  margin: 0 .15rem;
}


.effect-distribution-point {
  position: absolute;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--study-color, rgba(75, 85, 99, .52));
  border: 1.25px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .88);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 6;
}


.effect-distribution-snpster-mean {
  position: absolute;
  top: -7px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 27px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .86);
  border: 1px solid rgba(17, 24, 39, .22);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(17, 24, 39, .11);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 11;
  pointer-events: none;
}


.effect-distribution-median {
  position: absolute;
  top: -7px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 27px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .72);
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(71, 85, 105, .13);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 12;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-snpster-mean {
  top: 1px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 32px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-median {
  top: 1px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 32px;
}







/* ================================================================
   Outcome effect distributions
   Match the geometry of the percentile distribution:
   34px track, baseline through the visual center, jitter centered
   around that baseline, IQR band spanning the same vertical envelope.
   ================================================================ */

.effect-distribution-track,
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model {
  position: relative;
  height: 34px;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  margin-top: .35rem;
  margin-bottom: .15rem;
}

.effect-distribution-axis,
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-axis {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 0;
}

.effect-distribution-range,
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-range {
  position: absolute;
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 3;
}

.effect-distribution-iqr,
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-iqr {
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.effect-distribution-iqr.fill-increased {
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, .20);
  border: 1px solid rgba(217, 119, 6, .58);
}

.effect-distribution-iqr.fill-lowered {
  background: rgba(22, 163, 74, .18);
  border: 1px solid rgba(22, 163, 74, .52);
}

.effect-distribution-range.fill-increased {
  background: var(--risk-increased);
}

.effect-distribution-range.fill-lowered {
  background: var(--risk-lowered);
}

.effect-distribution-iqr.fill-beta {
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .20);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .58);
}

.effect-distribution-range.fill-beta {
  background: #2563eb;
}

.effect-distribution-point {
  position: absolute;
  top: 17px;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--study-color, rgba(75, 85, 99, .54));
  border: 1.25px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .92);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .14);
  transform:
    translate(-50%, -50%)
    translateY(var(--jitter-y, 0px));
  z-index: 7;
}

.effect-distribution-zero,
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-zero {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .58);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 5;
}

.effect-distribution-median,
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-median {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .78);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 12;
}

.effect-distribution-snpster-mean,
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-snpster-mean {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92);
  border: 1px solid rgba(17, 24, 39, .24);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(17, 24, 39, .12);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 11;
}

/* R² is kept separate from OR/HR because it is not an effect direction. */
.r2-evidence-block {
  margin-top: .7rem;
  padding-top: .62rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed #d9e1ea;
}

.r2-evidence-heading {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .61rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 820;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
}

.r2-evidence-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .42rem;
}

.r2-metric-chip {
  min-width: 145px;
  padding: .48rem .56rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .045);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .19);
  border-left: 3px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .72);
}

.r2-metric-chip-label {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .54rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 810;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .035em;
}

.r2-metric-chip-value {
  margin-top: .13rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .75rem;
  line-height: 1.18;
  font-weight: 880;
}

.r2-metric-chip-note {
  margin-top: .13rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .5rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}


/* Compact model-quality panel aligned to the percentile x-axis. */
.model-quality-panel {
  margin: .15rem 0 .7rem 0;
  padding: .52rem .62rem .46rem .62rem;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(248, 250, 252, .72);
}

.model-quality-panel-title {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: .8rem;
  margin-bottom: .32rem;
}

.model-quality-panel-title-main {
  color: #475569;
  font-size: .6rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: .025em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.model-quality-panel-title-note {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .49rem;
}

.quality-lane + .quality-lane {
  margin-top: .42rem;
}

.quality-lane-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: .7rem;
  margin-bottom: .1rem;
}

.quality-lane-label {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .54rem;
  font-weight: 820;
}

.quality-lane-scale {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .47rem;
  font-weight: 690;
}

.quality-scatter-track {
  position: relative;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: rgba(241, 245, 249, .55);
  overflow: visible;
}

.quality-r2-track {
  height: 28px;
}

.quality-gridline {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, .27);
  z-index: 0;
}

.quality-gridline-emphasis {
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .42);
}

.quality-gridline-label {
  position: absolute;
  right: 3px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  padding-left: .18rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  background: rgba(248, 250, 252, .9);
  font-size: .43rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  z-index: 1;
}

.quality-point {
  position: absolute;
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: var(--study-color, #64748b);
  border: 1.5px solid #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, .22);
  z-index: 5;
}

.quality-point-auroc {
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.quality-point-cindex {
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.quality-point-mixed {
  width: 11px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.quality-point-r2 {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.model-quality-caption {
  margin-top: .32rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .49rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.model-quality-legend {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .3rem;
  margin-left: .4rem;
}

.quality-shape-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  background: #64748b;
  border: 1px solid #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(100, 116, 139, .25);
}

.quality-shape-key.auroc {
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.quality-shape-key.cindex {
  border-radius: 1px;
}

.quality-shape-key.mixed {
  width: 9px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}


/* ================================================================
   Integrated percentile + model-quality figure

   The quality scatter and percentile distribution share the same x-axis:
       x = user's ancestry-standardized PGS percentile
       y = AUROC / C-index discrimination

   Standard R² is encoded by the size of a translucent halo around the
   discrimination marker, so R² is visible without putting it on the
   incompatible AUROC/C-index y-axis.
   ================================================================ */

.percentile-quality-composite {
  margin-top: .15rem;
}

.integrated-quality-scatter {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 .18rem 0;
}

.integrated-quality-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .8rem;
  margin-bottom: .16rem;
}

.integrated-quality-title {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .56rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 830;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.integrated-quality-note {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .47rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-align: right;
}

.integrated-quality-track {
  position: relative;
  height: 76px;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
}

.integrated-quality-gridline {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, .24);
  z-index: 0;
}

.integrated-quality-gridline.chance {
  height: 2px;
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .38);
}

.integrated-quality-y-label {
  position: absolute;
  right: 3px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  padding-left: .18rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: .44rem;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 700;
  z-index: 2;
}

.integrated-quality-stem {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  bottom: 0;
  background: var(--study-color, #94a3b8);
  opacity: .13;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 1;
}

.integrated-quality-point {
  position: absolute;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: var(--study-color, #64748b);
  border: 1.5px solid #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, .22);
  z-index: 6;
}

/* Circle = AUROC; square = C-index; pill = both types represented. */
.integrated-quality-point.auroc {
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.integrated-quality-point.cindex {
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.integrated-quality-point.mixed {
  width: 12px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

/* Standard R² halo.
   The exact R² value remains in the tooltip; halo diameter is a fixed
   monotonic visual encoding rather than a second y-axis. */
.integrated-quality-point.has-r2::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: var(--r2-halo-size, 14px);
  height: var(--r2-halo-size, 14px);
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--study-color, #64748b);
  opacity: .26;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.integrated-quality-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .3rem .65rem;
  margin-top: .22rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .46rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.integrated-quality-legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .24rem;
}

.integrated-quality-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  background: #64748b;
  border: 1px solid #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(100, 116, 139, .22);
}

.integrated-quality-key.auroc {
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.integrated-quality-key.cindex {
  border-radius: 1px;
}

.integrated-quality-key.mixed {
  width: 9px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.integrated-quality-key.r2 {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #64748b;
  opacity: .35;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* Visually bind the scatter to the percentile distribution below without
   creating another bordered "sub-card". */
.percentile-quality-divider {
  height: 1px;
  margin: .12rem 0 .08rem 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    rgba(203, 213, 225, .56) 8%,
    rgba(203, 213, 225, .56) 92%,
    transparent
  );
}


/* Standard R² bars inside the integrated model-quality scatter. */
.integrated-quality-r2-bar {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 7px;
  width: 9px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--study-color, #64748b);
  opacity: .20;
  border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--study-color, #64748b);
  z-index: 2;
}

.integrated-quality-r2-axis-label {
  position: absolute;
  left: 3px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .43rem;
  font-weight: 760;
  line-height: 1;
  background: transparent;
  z-index: 3;
}

.integrated-quality-r2-axis-title {
  position: absolute;
  left: 3px;
  top: -11px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .42rem;
  font-weight: 760;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  z-index: 3;
}

/* v8 no longer uses halo size as the R² encoding. */
.integrated-quality-point.has-r2::after {
  display: none;
}

/* Additional normalized quality/performance metrics. */
.other-quality-evidence {
  margin-top: .68rem;
  padding-top: .6rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed #d9e1ea;
}

.other-quality-heading {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .61rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 820;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: .38rem;
}

.other-quality-group + .other-quality-group {
  margin-top: .48rem;
}

.other-quality-group-label {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: .53rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 780;
  margin-bottom: .28rem;
}

.other-quality-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .4rem;
}

.other-quality-chip {
  min-width: 145px;
  max-width: 280px;
  padding: .44rem .54rem;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .23);
}

.other-quality-chip-label {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .53rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
```

```{python}
#| include: false
from IPython.display import HTML, display
import html
import math
import hashlib
import os
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent / "database_module"))

from db_handler import DbHandler, DbUtils
from db_config import USERNAME, PASSWORD, DATABASE_NAME, HOST, PORT, PGS_EXCEL_FILEPATH

db_handler = DbHandler(
    port=PORT,
    db_url=None,
    user=USERNAME,
    password=PASSWORD,
    host=HOST,
)
db_handler.connect()
db_utils = DbUtils(db_handler)

prsc_id = 3980  # placeholder for testing jobs


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Resolve the user's primary ancestry.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
ethnicity_query = f"""
SELECT * 
FROM snpster_users.user_ancestry
WHERE user_id = (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM snpster_users.imputation_jobs
    WHERE imputation_id IN (
        SELECT imputation_id
        FROM snpster_users.prsc_jobs
        WHERE prsc_id = {prsc_id}
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
"""

ancestry_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(ethnicity_query)

if ancestry_df.empty:
    raise ValueError(f"No ancestry record found for prsc_id={prsc_id}.")

primary_ancestry_code = ancestry_df["primary_ancestry"].iloc[0]

if pd.isna(primary_ancestry_code):
    raise ValueError(
        f"Primary ancestry has not been assigned for prsc_id={prsc_id}."
    )

primary_ancestry_code = str(primary_ancestry_code).strip().upper()

# Map SNPster's current ancestry codes onto broad ancestry labels used in
# evaluation_sample_sets.broad_ancestry_category.
#
# The ESS field can contain several comma-separated ancestry labels in one
# value, so the SQL below matches recognized tokens rather than requiring the
# whole field to equal one string. Ambiguous generic ancestry labels are not
# forced into a specific SNPster ancestry component.
#
# AFR is retained as a legacy alias for older records; the current schema uses
# SSA for Sub-Saharan African ancestry.
if primary_ancestry_code == "AFR":
    primary_ancestry_code = "SSA"

ancestry_display_map = {
    "EUR": "European",
    "EAS": "East Asian",
    "SAS": "South Asian",
    "SSA": "Sub-Saharan African",
    "MID": "Greater Middle Eastern",
    "AMR": "Hispanic / Latin American",
    "SEA": "South East Asian",
    "CAS": "Central Asian",
    "NAM": "Native American",
    "OCE": "Oceanian",
}

ancestry_token_map = {
    "EUR": [
        "European",
    ],
    "EAS": [
        "East Asian",
    ],
    "SAS": [
        "South Asian",
    ],
    "SSA": [
        "African unspecified",
        "African American or Afro-Caribbean",
        "Sub-Saharan African",
    ],
    "MID": [
        "Greater Middle Eastern",
        "Greater Middle Eastern (Middle Eastern, North African or Persian)",
    ],
    "AMR": [
        "Hispanic or Latin American",
    ],
    "SEA": [
        "South East Asian",
    ],
    "CAS": [
        "Central Asian",
    ],
    "NAM": [
        "Native American",
    ],
    "OCE": [
        "Oceanian",
    ],
}

if primary_ancestry_code not in ancestry_token_map:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Unsupported primary ancestry code: {primary_ancestry_code}"
    )

# Validation evidence is not restricted to one population for substantially
# admixed individuals. Any ancestry component above 20% contributes compatible
# evaluation cohorts; the recorded primary ancestry is always retained as a
# fallback even when no component exceeds the threshold.
MIXED_ANCESTRY_VALIDATION_THRESHOLD = 0.20

ancestry_fraction_column_map = {
    "EUR": "eur",
    "EAS": "eas",
    "SAS": "sas",
    "SSA": "ssa",
    "MID": "mid",
    "AMR": "amr",
    "SEA": "sea",
    "CAS": "cas",
    "NAM": "nam",
    "OCE": "oce",
}

ancestry_row = ancestry_df.iloc[0]
ancestry_fraction_by_code = {}

for code, column in ancestry_fraction_column_map.items():
    value = pd.to_numeric(
        pd.Series([ancestry_row.get(column, np.nan)]),
        errors="coerce",
    ).iloc[0]
    if not pd.isna(value):
        ancestry_fraction_by_code[code] = float(value)

selected_validation_ancestry_codes = [primary_ancestry_code]

additional_codes = sorted(
    [
        code
        for code, fraction in ancestry_fraction_by_code.items()
        if fraction > MIXED_ANCESTRY_VALIDATION_THRESHOLD
        and code != primary_ancestry_code
        and code in ancestry_token_map
    ],
    key=lambda code: (
        -ancestry_fraction_by_code.get(code, 0.0),
        code,
    ),
)
selected_validation_ancestry_codes.extend(additional_codes)

ancestry_tokens = []
seen_ancestry_tokens = set()
for code in selected_validation_ancestry_codes:
    for token in ancestry_token_map[code]:
        token_key = token.casefold().strip()
        if token_key and token_key not in seen_ancestry_tokens:
            seen_ancestry_tokens.add(token_key)
            ancestry_tokens.append(token)

ethnicity = " + ".join(
    ancestry_display_map[code]
    for code in selected_validation_ancestry_codes
)

# These labels are fixed application constants, but quote them defensively
# before embedding them into the SQL ARRAY literal.
ethnicity_sql = ethnicity.replace("'", "''")
ancestry_tokens_sql = ", ".join(
    "'" + token.replace("'", "''").lower() + "'"
    for token in ancestry_tokens
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1b. Resolve report identity and generation metadata.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
report_job_query = f"""
SELECT ij.*
FROM snpster_users.prsc_jobs AS pj
JOIN snpster_users.imputation_jobs AS ij
    ON ij.imputation_id = pj.imputation_id
WHERE pj.prsc_id = {prsc_id}
LIMIT 1
"""

report_job_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(report_job_query)

if report_job_df.empty:
    raise ValueError(
        f"No imputation-job context found for prsc_id={prsc_id}."
    )

report_job_row = report_job_df.iloc[0]
report_user_id = str(report_job_row.get("user_id", "Unknown profile")).strip()
report_user_id_sql = report_user_id.replace("'", "''")

report_imputation_id = int(report_job_row["imputation_id"])

report_sections_query = """
SELECT
    category_id,
    category_key,
    display_name AS report_name,
    description,
    display_order
FROM data_libraries.report_categories
WHERE is_active
ORDER BY display_order, display_name
"""

report_sections_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(
    report_sections_query
)

if report_sections_df.empty:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "No active report categories found in data_libraries.report_categories. "
        "Run the DB curation migration and seed script first."
    )

report_section_names = (
    report_sections_df["report_name"]
    .dropna()
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .loc[lambda values: values.ne("")]
    .tolist()
)

CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS_DB = {
    str(row["report_name"]).strip(): str(row.get("description", "") or "").strip()
    for _, row in report_sections_df.iterrows()
}


def first_nonempty_value(row, candidates):
    """Return the first non-empty value from candidate columns."""
    if row is None:
        return None

    for column in candidates:
        if column not in row.index:
            continue

        value = row[column]

        if pd.isna(value):
            continue

        value = str(value).strip()

        if value:
            return value

    return None


try:
    report_profile_query = f"""
    SELECT *
    FROM snpster_users.user_information
    WHERE user_id = '{report_user_id_sql}'
    LIMIT 1
    """
    report_profile_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(
        report_profile_query
    )
except Exception:
    report_profile_df = pd.DataFrame()

report_profile_row = (
    report_profile_df.iloc[0]
    if not report_profile_df.empty
    else None
)

report_full_name = first_nonempty_value(
    report_profile_row,
    [
        "full_name",
        "display_name",
        "name",
        "user_name",
        "username",
    ],
)

if report_full_name is None:
    report_first_name = first_nonempty_value(
        report_profile_row,
        ["first_name", "firstname", "given_name"],
    )
    report_last_name = first_nonempty_value(
        report_profile_row,
        ["last_name", "lastname", "family_name", "surname"],
    )
    report_full_name = " ".join(
        value
        for value in [report_first_name, report_last_name]
        if value
    ).strip()

if not report_full_name:
    report_full_name = report_user_id

report_data_source = first_nonempty_value(
    report_job_row,
    [
        "data_source",
        "genotyping_vendor",
        "vendor",
        "source_vendor",
        "file_provider",
        "input_vendor",
        "provider",
    ],
)

if report_data_source is None:
    report_data_source = "Uploaded genotype data"

report_now = datetime.now()
report_date = (
    f"{report_now.strftime('%B')} {report_now.day}, {report_now.year}"
)
report_identifier = f"SNPSTER-{prsc_id}"
report_version = "1.0"


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Find PSS IDs relevant to that ancestry, then use those PSS IDs
#    to retrieve their PPM performance rows.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
query = f"""
WITH latest_user_results AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pjr.pgs_id)
        pjr.*
    FROM snpster_users.prsc_job_results AS pjr
    INNER JOIN snpster_users.prsc_jobs AS pj
        ON pj.prsc_id = pjr.prsc_id
    WHERE pj.imputation_id = {report_imputation_id}
      AND pj.prsc_status = 'completed'
    ORDER BY
        pjr.pgs_id,
        COALESCE(pj.completed_at, pj.started_at, pj.created_at) DESC,
        pj.prsc_id DESC
),

ancestry_matched_ess AS (
    SELECT ess.*
    FROM data_libraries.evaluation_sample_sets AS ess
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM unnest(
            string_to_array(
                COALESCE(ess.broad_ancestry_category, ''),
                ','
            )
        ) AS ancestry_token(value)
        WHERE lower(btrim(ancestry_token.value)) = ANY (
            ARRAY[{ancestry_tokens_sql}]::text[]
        )
    )
),

ancestry_matched_pss AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pgs_id,
        pss_id
    FROM ancestry_matched_ess
),

ancestry_matched_pss_stats AS (
    SELECT
        pgs_id,
        pss_id,

        SUM(
            COALESCE(
                individuals_evaluation,
                COALESCE(cases_evaluation, 0)
                + COALESCE(controls_evaluation, 0)
            )
        ) AS individuals_evaluation,

        SUM(cases_evaluation) AS cases_evaluation,
        SUM(controls_evaluation) AS controls_evaluation

    FROM ancestry_matched_ess

    GROUP BY
        pgs_id,
        pss_id
),

matched_pss_metadata AS (
    SELECT
        matched.pgs_id,
        matched.pss_id,

        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(ess.cohort), ''),
            ' / '
            ORDER BY NULLIF(BTRIM(ess.cohort), '')
        ) AS cohort

    FROM ancestry_matched_pss AS matched

    LEFT JOIN data_libraries.evaluation_sample_sets AS ess
        ON BTRIM(ess.pss_id) = BTRIM(matched.pss_id)
       AND BTRIM(ess.pgs_id) = BTRIM(matched.pgs_id)

    GROUP BY
        matched.pgs_id,
        matched.pss_id
)

SELECT
    pjr.pgs_id,
    rsc.reported_trait AS reported_trait,
    rsc.category AS report_name,
    pcd.reported_trait AS source_reported_trait,
    pcd.mapped_trait_efo_label,
    pcd.efo_id,
    pp.reported_trait AS specific_trait,
    pp.reported_trait AS evaluation_outcome_raw,
    pp.evaluation_outcome_clean,
    pp.evaluation_outcome_key,
    pp.evaluation_target_trait,
    pp.evaluation_target_category,

    pjr.percentile_most_similar_pop,
    pjr.z_most_similar_pop,
    pjr.z_norm1,
    pjr.z_norm2,
    pjr.percent_variants_matched,
    pjr.n_variants_matched,

    pp.ppm_id,
    pp.pss_id,
    pp.pgp_id,

    pss_stats.individuals_evaluation,
    pss_stats.cases_evaluation,
    pss_stats.controls_evaluation,
    pss_metadata.cohort,
    '{ethnicity_sql}' AS broad_ancestry_category,

    pp.pgs_performance_other_relevant_info,
    pp.has_covariates,
    pp.covariate_class,
    pp.clinical_predictors_present,
    pp.clinical_predictor_terms,
    pp.population_scope_hint,
    pp.population_scope_confidence,
    pp.population_scope_reason,
    pp.applicability_status,
    pp.applicability_requires_match,
    pp.applicability_restriction_types,
    pp.applicability_reason,
    pp.age_restriction_min_years,
    pp.age_restriction_max_years,
    pp.sex_restriction,
    pp.condition_restriction,
    pp.sample_age_raw,
    pp.sample_age_mean_years,
    pp.sample_age_min_years,
    pp.sample_age_max_years,
    pp.phenotype_definition_raw,
    pp.additional_sample_info_raw,
    pp.publication_pmid,
    pp.publication_doi,

    pp.hazard_ratio,
    pp.odds_ratio,
    pp.beta,
    pp.auroc AS published_auroc_raw,
    pp.concordance_statistic AS published_concordance_statistic_raw,
    pp.primary_quality_auroc AS auroc,
    pp.primary_quality_c_index AS concordance_statistic,

    pp.odds_ratio_estimate,
    pp.odds_ratio_ci_lower,
    pp.odds_ratio_ci_upper,
    pp.odds_ratio_basis,
    pp.odds_ratio_personalization_allowed
        AS odds_ratio_use_for_personalized_effect,

    pp.hazard_ratio_estimate,
    pp.hazard_ratio_ci_lower,
    pp.hazard_ratio_ci_upper,
    pp.hazard_ratio_basis,
    pp.hazard_ratio_personalization_allowed
        AS hazard_ratio_use_for_personalized_effect,

    pp.beta_estimate,
    pp.beta_ci_lower,
    pp.beta_ci_upper,
    pp.beta_basis,
    pp.beta_personalization_allowed
        AS beta_use_for_personalized_effect,

    pp.r2_value AS other_r2_value,
    pp.incremental_r2_value AS other_incremental_r2_value,
    pp.partial_r2_value AS other_partial_r2_value,
    pp.pseudo_r2_value AS other_pseudo_r2_value,
    pp.adjusted_r2_value AS other_adjusted_r2_value,
    pp.liability_r2_value AS other_liability_r2_value,

    pp.group_odds_ratio_raw AS other_group_odds_ratio_raw,
    pp.group_hazard_ratio_raw AS other_group_hazard_ratio_raw,
    pp.relative_risk_raw AS other_relative_risk_raw,
    pp.relative_risk_ratio_raw AS other_relative_risk_ratio_raw,
    pp.incidence_rate_ratio_raw AS other_incidence_rate_ratio_raw,

    pub.first_author,
    pub.title,
    pub.journal_name,
    pub.publication_date,
    pub.release_date AS publication_release_date,
    pub.authors,
    pub.pubmed_id_pmid,
    pub.digital_object_identifier_doi,

    pcd.publication_pmid AS development_publication_pmid,
    pcd.publication_doi AS development_publication_doi,
    pcd.pgp_id AS development_pgp_id,
    pcd.number_of_variants,
    pcd.original_genome_build,
    pcd.type_of_variant_weight,
    pcd.pgs_development_method,
    pcd.release_date AS pgs_release_date

FROM latest_user_results AS pjr

INNER JOIN data_libraries.report_score_catalog_v AS rsc
    ON rsc.pgs_id = pjr.pgs_id

INNER JOIN data_libraries.pgscatalog_data AS pcd
    ON pcd.pgs_id = pjr.pgs_id

-- Step 1: retain PSS IDs matching the selected validation ancestries.
INNER JOIN ancestry_matched_pss AS matched_pss
    ON matched_pss.pgs_id = pjr.pgs_id

-- Step 2: use those PSS IDs to retrieve the associated PPM records.
INNER JOIN data_libraries.pgs_performance_curated_v AS pp
    ON pp.pgs_id = matched_pss.pgs_id
   AND pp.pss_id = matched_pss.pss_id

-- Descriptive sample-size metadata for the already-selected ancestry rows.
LEFT JOIN ancestry_matched_pss_stats AS pss_stats
    ON pss_stats.pgs_id = matched_pss.pgs_id
   AND pss_stats.pss_id = matched_pss.pss_id

LEFT JOIN matched_pss_metadata AS pss_metadata
    ON pss_metadata.pgs_id = matched_pss.pgs_id
   AND pss_metadata.pss_id = matched_pss.pss_id

LEFT JOIN data_libraries.pgs_publications AS pub
    ON pub.pgp_id = pp.pgp_id

ORDER BY
    rsc.category_display_order,
    rsc.reported_trait,
    pjr.pgs_id,
    pss_stats.individuals_evaluation DESC,
    pp.ppm_id;
"""

data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(query)
data = data.drop_duplicates()

# All structured performance semantics now come directly from PostgreSQL via
# data_libraries.pgs_performance_curated_v. No report-time CSV merge is needed.
data["ppm_id"] = data["ppm_id"].astype(str).str.strip()

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull ALL normalized performance metrics for the PPMs in this report.
#
# This is the catch-all data source for metric families that do not have
# dedicated columns in pgs_performance (e.g. partial correlation, AUPRC,
# delta AUROC, Brier score, NRI, sensitivity/specificity, etc.).
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
R2_DB_METRIC_TYPES = [
    "r2",
    "incremental_r2",
    "partial_r2",
    "adjusted_r2",
    "liability_r2",
    "pseudo_r2",
]

ppm_ids_for_metrics = sorted(
    {
        value
        for value in data["ppm_id"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip()
        if value
    }
)

if ppm_ids_for_metrics:
    ppm_ids_sql = ", ".join(
        "'" + value.replace("'", "''") + "'"
        for value in ppm_ids_for_metrics
    )

    performance_metric_query = f"""
    SELECT
        mv.ppm_id,
        mv.metric_type,
        mv.metric_index,
        mv.source,
        mv.metric_label_raw,
        mv.estimate,
        mv.ci_lower,
        mv.ci_upper,
        mv.effect_basis,
        mv.personalization_allowed,
        mv.display_mode,
        mv.unit,
        mv.contrast_text,
        mv.raw_metric,
        mv.metric_family,
        mv.metric_model_scope,
        mv.metric_model_scope_confidence,
        mv.metric_model_scope_reason,
        mv.r2_scale_basis,
        mv.r2_estimate_canonical_fraction,
        mv.r2_estimate_display_percent,
        mv.r2_ci_lower_canonical_fraction,
        mv.r2_ci_upper_canonical_fraction,
        mv.r2_scale_reason,
        mv.quality_plot_role,
        mv.quality_context_warning,
        mv.preferred_for_primary_quality,
        pp.applicability_status,
        pp.applicability_requires_match,
        pp.applicability_restriction_types,
        pp.applicability_reason
    FROM data_libraries.pgs_performance_metric_values AS mv
    JOIN data_libraries.pgs_performance AS pp
      ON pp.ppm_id = mv.ppm_id
    WHERE mv.ppm_id IN ({ppm_ids_sql})
      AND mv.estimate IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY
        mv.ppm_id,
        mv.metric_type,
        mv.metric_index;
    """

    performance_metric_data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(
        performance_metric_query
    )

    if not performance_metric_data.empty:
        performance_metric_data["ppm_id"] = (
            performance_metric_data["ppm_id"]
            .astype(str)
            .str.strip()
        )

        for numeric_col in [
            "estimate",
            "ci_lower",
            "ci_upper",
        ]:
            performance_metric_data[numeric_col] = pd.to_numeric(
                performance_metric_data[numeric_col],
                errors="coerce",
            )

        performance_metric_data = performance_metric_data[
            performance_metric_data["estimate"].notna()
        ].copy()
else:
    performance_metric_data = pd.DataFrame(
        columns=[
            "ppm_id",
            "metric_type",
            "metric_index",
            "source",
            "metric_label_raw",
            "estimate",
            "ci_lower",
            "ci_upper",
            "effect_basis",
            "personalization_allowed",
            "display_mode",
            "unit",
            "contrast_text",
            "raw_metric",
            "metric_family",
            "metric_model_scope",
            "metric_model_scope_confidence",
            "metric_model_scope_reason",
            "r2_scale_basis",
            "r2_estimate_canonical_fraction",
            "r2_estimate_display_percent",
            "r2_ci_lower_canonical_fraction",
            "r2_ci_upper_canonical_fraction",
            "r2_scale_reason",
            "quality_plot_role",
            "quality_context_warning",
            "preferred_for_primary_quality",
            "applicability_status",
            "applicability_requires_match",
            "applicability_restriction_types",
            "applicability_reason",
        ]
    )

if not performance_metric_data.empty:
    metric_restriction_flag = (
        performance_metric_data["applicability_requires_match"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.casefold()
        .isin({"true", "1", "yes"})
    )
    metric_scope = (
        performance_metric_data["metric_model_scope"]
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )
else:
    metric_restriction_flag = pd.Series(dtype=bool)
    metric_scope = pd.Series(dtype=str)

r2_metric_data = performance_metric_data[
    performance_metric_data["metric_type"].isin(R2_DB_METRIC_TYPES)
    & ~metric_restriction_flag
    & ~metric_scope.isin({
        "clinical_or_comparator_model",
        "pgs_plus_clinical_predictors",
    })
].copy()

if performance_metric_data.empty:
    print(
        "NOTE: no normalized performance metric rows were available for "
        "the PPMs selected for this report. Check "
        "data_libraries.pgs_performance_metric_values if this is unexpected."
    )
else:
    print(
        "Loaded "
        f"{len(performance_metric_data)} normalized performance metric rows "
        f"for report rendering, including {len(r2_metric_data)} R²-family rows."
    )

# Pull conservatively curated beta units from the normalized metric table.
if ppm_ids_for_metrics:
    beta_unit_query = f"""
    SELECT
        ppm_id,
        unit
    FROM data_libraries.pgs_performance_metric_values
    WHERE ppm_id IN ({ppm_ids_sql})
      AND metric_type = 'beta'
      AND source = 'dedicated'
      AND unit IS NOT NULL
      AND BTRIM(unit) <> ''
    ORDER BY ppm_id, metric_index;
    """

    beta_unit_data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(
        beta_unit_query
    )

    if not beta_unit_data.empty:
        beta_unit_data["ppm_id"] = (
            beta_unit_data["ppm_id"].astype(str).str.strip()
        )
        beta_unit_data["unit"] = (
            beta_unit_data["unit"].astype(str).str.strip()
        )
        beta_unit_data = beta_unit_data.drop_duplicates(
            subset=["ppm_id"],
            keep="first",
        )
else:
    beta_unit_data = pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["ppm_id", "unit"]
    )

if beta_unit_data.empty:
    data["beta_unit"] = None
else:
    beta_unit_lookup = dict(
        zip(
            beta_unit_data["ppm_id"],
            beta_unit_data["unit"],
        )
    )
    data["beta_unit"] = data["ppm_id"].map(
        beta_unit_lookup
    )
```
