```{python}
def percentile_values(models_df):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    return pd.to_numeric(models_df["percentile_norm2"], errors="coerce").dropna()


def percentile_distribution_stats(models_df):
    """Unweighted descriptive statistics across retained PGS percentiles.

    AUROC and concordance belong to individual validation records and therefore
    do not weight or shift the percentile summary.
    """
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return None

    values_series = pd.to_numeric(
        models_df["percentile_norm2"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).dropna()

    if values_series.empty:
        return None

    values_series = values_series.astype(float)
    values = values_series.to_numpy()

    mean = float(values_series.mean())
    sd = float(values_series.std()) if len(values) > 1 else 0.0

    q1 = float(values_series.quantile(0.25))
    median = float(values_series.median())
    q3 = float(values_series.quantile(0.75))
    minimum = float(values_series.min())
    maximum = float(values_series.max())
    iqr = q3 - q1

    lower_fence = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
    upper_fence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr

    lower_candidates = values_series[values_series >= lower_fence]
    upper_candidates = values_series[values_series <= upper_fence]

    lower_whisker = (
        float(lower_candidates.min())
        if not lower_candidates.empty
        else minimum
    )
    upper_whisker = (
        float(upper_candidates.max())
        if not upper_candidates.empty
        else maximum
    )

    return {
        "n": len(values),
        "mean": mean,
        "sd": sd,
        "q1": q1,
        "median": median,
        "q3": q3,
        "min": minimum,
        "max": maximum,
        "iqr_width": float(iqr),
        "range_width": float(maximum - minimum),
        "lower_whisker": lower_whisker,
        "upper_whisker": upper_whisker,
    }



def percentile_risk_category(percentile):
    """Return the report's qualitative risk category for one percentile."""
    if pd.isna(percentile):
        return None
    return risk_level(float(percentile))[0]


def classify_agreement_spread(spread_width):
    """Classify model agreement from percentile spread only."""
    spread_width = float(spread_width)

    if spread_width < 5:
        return "Very high", "phenomenal"
    if spread_width < 10:
        return "High", "very-good"
    if spread_width < 20:
        return "Moderate", "good"
    if spread_width <= 25:
        return "Low", "moderate"
    return "Very low", "bad"


def model_agreement_stats(models_df):
    """Assess agreement from percentile spread.

    For cards using the multi-PGS boxplot view (>4 percentile values), agreement
    is based on IQR width.

    For cards without the boxplot view (2-4 percentile values), agreement is
    based on the full min-to-max distance.

    Thresholds:
      <5    = Very high
      <10   = High
      <20   = Moderate
      20-25 = Low
      >25   = Very low
    """
    stats = percentile_distribution_stats(models_df)
    if stats is None:
        return None

    n = int(stats["n"])

    if n == 1:
        return {
            "n": 1,
            "status": "Not assessable",
            "status_class": "not-assessable",
            "spread_type": "single",
            "spread_width": 0.0,
        }

    if use_distribution_percentile_view(models_df):
        spread_type = "IQR"
        spread_width = float(stats["iqr_width"])
    else:
        spread_type = "Range"
        spread_width = float(stats["range_width"])

    status, status_class = classify_agreement_spread(spread_width)

    return {
        "n": n,
        "status": status,
        "status_class": status_class,
        "spread_type": spread_type,
        "spread_width": spread_width,
    }


def make_model_agreement(models_df):
    """Render a compact model-agreement tag for the card header."""
    stats = model_agreement_stats(models_df)

    if stats is None:
        return ""

    if stats["n"] == 1:
        title = "Model agreement cannot be assessed from a single retained PGS model"
    else:
        title = (
            f"Agreement based on {stats['spread_type']} spread of "
            f"{stats['spread_width']:.1f} percentile points across "
            f"{stats['n']} retained PGS models"
        )

    return f"""
    <div class="model-agreement-header" title="{html.escape(title)}">
      <span class="model-agreement-badge model-agreement-{html.escape(stats['status_class'])}">
        Model agreement · {html.escape(stats['status'])}
      </span>
    </div>
    """



def use_distribution_percentile_view(models_df):
    """Use multi-model median/IQR display for traits with more than 4 retained scores."""
    return len(percentile_values(models_df)) > 4


def make_percentile_jitter_points(models_df):
    """
    Jitter retained-model percentile points around the main percentile bar.

    Publication colors are assigned locally within this consumer card so
    different source papers remain visually distinct.
    """
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return "", ""

    local_color_map = build_local_development_color_map(models_df)

    rows = models_df.copy()
    rows["percentile_numeric"] = pd.to_numeric(
        rows["percentile_norm2"],
        errors="coerce",
    )
    rows = rows[rows["percentile_numeric"].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)

    if len(rows) <= 1:
        return "", ""

    # Keep points near the middle so the IQR extends beyond them vertically.
    vertical_offsets = [1, 6, 0, 7, 2, 5, 1, 6]
    points = []

    for i, row in rows.iterrows():
        pct = clamp_percentile(row["percentile_numeric"])
        top = vertical_offsets[i % len(vertical_offsets)]
        pgs_id = html.escape(str(row.get("pgs_id", "PGS model")))
        study_key, study_label = development_study_identity(row)
        point_color = study_color_local(study_key, local_color_map)
        points.append(
            f'<span class="percentile-model-point" '
            f'title="{pgs_id} · {html.escape(study_label)}: '
            f'{fmt_percentile(pct)} percentile" '
            f'style="--study-color: {point_color}; '
            f'left: {pct:.2f}%; top: {top}px;"></span>'
        )

    legend = (
        '<span class="legend-item">'
        '<span class="legend-model-point-key"></span>'
        'PGS model · color groups source publication'
        '</span>'
    )

    return "".join(points), legend


def percentile_axis_labels():
    """Fixed 0-100 percentile x-axis shown beneath percentile bars."""
    ticks = [
        (0, "0"),
        (25, "25"),
        (50, "50"),
        (75, "75"),
        (100, "100"),
    ]

    labels = []
    for i, (position, label) in enumerate(ticks):
        edge_class = ""
        if i == 0:
            edge_class = " edge-left"
        elif i == len(ticks) - 1:
            edge_class = " edge-right"

        labels.append(
            f'<span class="scale-axis-label{edge_class}" '
            f'style="left: {position:.1f}%;">{label}</span>'
        )

    return f"""
    <div class="scale-axis-labels" aria-label="Percentile axis from 0 to 100">
      {''.join(labels)}
    </div>
    """


def make_percentile_distribution_view(models_df, fill_class):
    """
    Use a boxplot-style percentile display for >4 retained models.

    Publication colors are assigned locally within this consumer card.
    """
    stats = percentile_distribution_stats(models_df)
    if stats is None:
        return ""

    local_color_map = build_local_development_color_map(models_df)

    q1 = clamp_percentile(stats["q1"])
    q3 = clamp_percentile(stats["q3"])
    median = clamp_percentile(stats["median"])
    lower_whisker = clamp_percentile(stats["lower_whisker"])
    upper_whisker = clamp_percentile(stats["upper_whisker"])

    iqr_left = q1
    iqr_width = max(0.0, q3 - q1)
    whisker_left = lower_whisker
    whisker_width = max(0.0, upper_whisker - lower_whisker)

    rows = models_df.copy()
    rows["percentile_numeric"] = pd.to_numeric(
        rows["percentile_norm2"],
        errors="coerce",
    )
    rows = rows[rows["percentile_numeric"].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Keep dense points inside the taller IQR envelope.
    jitter_offsets = [10, 17, 8, 19, 12, 15, 9, 18]
    jitter_points = []

    for i, row in rows.iterrows():
        pct = clamp_percentile(row["percentile_numeric"])
        top = jitter_offsets[i % len(jitter_offsets)]
        pgs_id = html.escape(str(row.get("pgs_id", "PGS model")))
        study_key, study_label = development_study_identity(row)
        point_color = study_color_local(study_key, local_color_map)
        jitter_points.append(
            f'<span class="percentile-distribution-point" '
            f'title="{pgs_id} · {html.escape(study_label)}: '
            f'{fmt_percentile(pct)} percentile" '
            f'style="--study-color: {point_color}; '
            f'left: {pct:.2f}%; top: {top}px;"></span>'
        )

    return f"""
    <div class="percentile-distribution" aria-label="Percentile distribution across retained PGS models">
      <div class="percentile-distribution-track">
        <div class="percentile-distribution-axis" title="Full percentile scale"></div>
        <div class="percentile-distribution-whisker {fill_class}" title="Boxplot whisker range: {fmt_percentile(lower_whisker)}–{fmt_percentile(upper_whisker)}" style="left: {whisker_left:.1f}%; width: {whisker_width:.1f}%;"></div>
        <div class="percentile-distribution-iqr" title="Interquartile range: {fmt_percentile(q1)}–{fmt_percentile(q3)}" style="left: {iqr_left:.1f}%; width: {iqr_width:.1f}%;"></div>
        {''.join(jitter_points)}
        <div class="percentile-distribution-mean" title="Median percentile: {fmt_percentile(median)}" style="left: {median:.1f}%;"></div>
      </div>
      {percentile_axis_labels()}
      <div class="percentile-distribution-caption">IQR {fmt_percentile(stats['q1'])}–{fmt_percentile(stats['q3'])} · SD {stats['sd']:.1f} percentile points</div>
    </div>
    """


def make_consensus_box(models_df, primary_percentile):
    values = percentile_values(models_df)

    # For traits with many retained models, the main visualization already shows
    # median, family-weighted mean, IQR, observed range, and SD. Do not show the older consensus/disagreement panel.
    if use_distribution_percentile_view(models_df):
        return ""

    if len(values) <= 1:
        return ""

    low = values.min()
    high = values.max()
    range_text = fmt_percentile_range(low, high)

    return f"""
    <div class="consensus-box">
      <div class="metric-label">Multi-model consensus</div>
      <div class="consensus-value">{html.escape(range_text)}</div>
      <div class="metric-caption">Range across {len(values)} retained PGS models. Consensus area = solid bar; model disagreement range = translucent band.</div>
    </div>
    """



def _quality_discrimination_rows(pgs_ppms):
    if pgs_ppms is None or pgs_ppms.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    work = pgs_ppms.copy()
    work["_auroc"] = pd.to_numeric(
        work.get("auroc", np.nan),
        errors="coerce",
    )
    work["_cindex"] = pd.to_numeric(
        work.get("concordance_statistic", np.nan),
        errors="coerce",
    )
    work["_quality_value"] = work["_auroc"].combine_first(
        work["_cindex"]
    )
    work["_quality_kind"] = np.where(
        work["_auroc"].notna(),
        "AUROC",
        np.where(work["_cindex"].notna(), "C-index", None),
    )

    return work[
        work["_quality_value"].notna()
    ].copy()


def _quality_r2_values_for_pgs(pgs_ppms):
    """
    Standard R² only. Incremental/partial/adjusted/liability/pseudo-R² remain
    in their separate outcome-evidence display.
    """
    if (
        pgs_ppms is None
        or pgs_ppms.empty
        or r2_metric_data is None
        or r2_metric_data.empty
    ):
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)

    ppm_ids = {
        value
        for value in pgs_ppms["ppm_id"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        if value
    }

    if not ppm_ids:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)

    subset = r2_metric_data[
        r2_metric_data["ppm_id"].isin(ppm_ids)
        & r2_metric_data["metric_type"].eq("r2")
    ].copy()

    values = pd.to_numeric(
        subset["estimate"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).dropna()

    if values.empty:
        return values

    return values.map(r2_to_percentage_points)


def _nice_r2_scale_max(values):
    values = pd.to_numeric(
        pd.Series(values),
        errors="coerce",
    ).dropna()

    if values.empty:
        return 10.0

    target = max(
        10.0,
        float(values.max()) * 1.12,
    )

    if target <= 10:
        return 10.0
    if target <= 20:
        return 20.0
    if target <= 50:
        return 50.0
    if target <= 100:
        return 100.0

    return float(math.ceil(target / 50.0) * 50.0)


def make_model_quality_panel(models_df, quality_ppms):
    """
    Combined quality/percentile visualization.

    x = user's ancestry-standardized percentile for each retained PGS.
    point y = median AUROC/C-index for that PGS.
    thin bar = median STANDARD R² on a separate local R² scale.

    A PGS with R² but no AUROC/C-index still gets an R² bar.
    """
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return ""

    if quality_ppms is None:
        quality_ppms = pd.DataFrame()

    local_color_map = build_local_development_color_map(
        models_df
    )

    rows = []

    for _, model in models_df.iterrows():
        pgs_id = str(
            model.get("pgs_id", "")
        ).strip()

        percentile = pd.to_numeric(
            model.get("percentile_norm2", np.nan),
            errors="coerce",
        )

        if not pgs_id or pd.isna(percentile):
            continue

        if quality_ppms.empty:
            pgs_ppms = pd.DataFrame()
        else:
            pgs_ppms = quality_ppms[
                quality_ppms["pgs_id"]
                .astype(str)
                .eq(pgs_id)
            ].copy()

        discrimination_rows = _quality_discrimination_rows(
            pgs_ppms
        )

        discrimination = np.nan
        discrimination_kind = None
        shape_class = None
        n_discrimination = 0

        if not discrimination_rows.empty:
            discrimination = float(
                discrimination_rows[
                    "_quality_value"
                ].median()
            )

            kinds = set(
                discrimination_rows["_quality_kind"]
                .dropna()
                .astype(str)
            )

            if kinds == {"AUROC"}:
                discrimination_kind = "AUROC"
                shape_class = "auroc"
            elif kinds == {"C-index"}:
                discrimination_kind = "C-index"
                shape_class = "cindex"
            else:
                discrimination_kind = "AUROC / C-index"
                shape_class = "mixed"

            n_discrimination = int(
                len(discrimination_rows)
            )

        r2_values = _quality_r2_values_for_pgs(
            pgs_ppms
        )

        r2_median = (
            float(r2_values.median())
            if not r2_values.empty
            else np.nan
        )

        if pd.isna(discrimination) and pd.isna(r2_median):
            continue

        study_key, study_label = development_study_identity(
            model
        )

        rows.append({
            "pgs_id": pgs_id,
            "percentile": clamp_percentile(
                percentile
            ),
            "study_label": study_label,
            "color": study_color_local(
                study_key,
                local_color_map,
            ),
            "discrimination": discrimination,
            "discrimination_kind": discrimination_kind,
            "shape_class": shape_class,
            "n_discrimination": n_discrimination,
            "r2": r2_median,
            "n_r2": int(len(r2_values)),
        })

    if not rows:
        return ""

    discrimination_values = [
        row["discrimination"]
        for row in rows
        if not pd.isna(row["discrimination"])
    ]

    r2_values_all = [
        row["r2"]
        for row in rows
        if not pd.isna(row["r2"])
    ]

    has_discrimination = bool(
        discrimination_values
    )
    has_r2 = bool(
        r2_values_all
    )

    if has_discrimination:
        min_discrimination = min(
            discrimination_values
        )

        if min_discrimination < 0.50:
            y_low = max(
                0.0,
                math.floor(
                    min_discrimination * 20.0
                ) / 20.0 - 0.05,
            )
        else:
            y_low = 0.50
    else:
        y_low = 0.50

    y_high = 1.00

    r2_max = (
        _nice_r2_scale_max(
            r2_values_all
        )
        if has_r2
        else 10.0
    )

    track_top = 5.0
    track_bottom = 69.0
    usable_height = (
        track_bottom - track_top
    )

    def discrimination_y_position(value):
        clamped = max(
            y_low,
            min(y_high, float(value)),
        )

        fraction = (
            (clamped - y_low)
            / (y_high - y_low)
            if y_high > y_low
            else 0.0
        )

        return (
            track_bottom
            - fraction * usable_height
        )

    def r2_bar_height(value):
        if value is None or pd.isna(value):
            return 0.0

        clamped = max(
            0.0,
            min(r2_max, float(value)),
        )

        return (
            (clamped / r2_max)
            * usable_height
            if r2_max > 0
            else 0.0
        )

    grid_html = []

    if has_discrimination:
        grid_values = [
            1.00,
            0.75,
            0.50,
        ]

        if y_low < 0.50:
            grid_values.append(
                y_low
            )

        for value in sorted(
            set(grid_values),
            reverse=True,
        ):
            if value < y_low or value > y_high:
                continue

            top = discrimination_y_position(
                value
            )

            chance_class = (
                " chance"
                if abs(value - 0.50) < 1e-9
                else ""
            )

            grid_html.append(
                f'<div class="integrated-quality-gridline'
                f'{chance_class}" '
                f'style="top: {top:.2f}px;"></div>'
            )

            grid_html.append(
                f'<span class="integrated-quality-y-label" '
                f'style="top: {top:.2f}px;">'
                f'{value:.2f}</span>'
            )

    r2_axis_html = ""

    if has_r2:
        r2_mid = r2_max / 2.0

        r2_axis_html = f"""
        <span class="integrated-quality-r2-axis-title">
          R² bars
        </span>
        <span class="integrated-quality-r2-axis-label"
              style="top: {track_top:.2f}px;">
          {r2_max:.0f}%
        </span>
        <span class="integrated-quality-r2-axis-label"
              style="top: {(track_top + track_bottom) / 2.0:.2f}px;">
          {r2_mid:.0f}%
        </span>
        <span class="integrated-quality-r2-axis-label"
              style="top: {track_bottom:.2f}px;">
          0%
        </span>
        """

    mark_html = []

    for row in rows:
        if not pd.isna(row["r2"]):
            height = r2_bar_height(
                row["r2"]
            )

            mark_html.append(
                f'<span class="integrated-quality-r2-bar" '
                f'title="{html.escape(row["pgs_id"])} · '
                f'{html.escape(row["study_label"])} · '
                f'standard R² {row["r2"]:.2f}% '
                f'({row["n_r2"]} '
                f'{plural_word(row["n_r2"], "estimate")})" '
                f'style="--study-color: {row["color"]}; '
                f'left: {row["percentile"]:.2f}%; '
                f'height: {height:.2f}px;"></span>'
            )

        if not pd.isna(row["discrimination"]):
            top = discrimination_y_position(
                row["discrimination"]
            )

            stem_height = max(
                0.0,
                track_bottom - top,
            )

            mark_html.append(
                f'<span class="integrated-quality-stem" '
                f'style="--study-color: '
                f'{row["color"]}; '
                f'left: {row["percentile"]:.2f}%; '
                f'height: {stem_height:.2f}px;"></span>'
            )

            mark_html.append(
                f'<span class="integrated-quality-point '
                f'{row["shape_class"]}" '
                f'title="{html.escape(row["pgs_id"])} · '
                f'{html.escape(row["study_label"])} · '
                f'{html.escape(row["discrimination_kind"])} '
                f'{row["discrimination"]:.3f}" '
                f'style="--study-color: {row["color"]}; '
                f'left: {row["percentile"]:.2f}%; '
                f'top: {top:.2f}px;"></span>'
            )

    n_models = len(models_df)
    n_discrimination_models = sum(
        not pd.isna(row["discrimination"])
        for row in rows
    )
    n_r2_models = sum(
        not pd.isna(row["r2"])
        for row in rows
    )

    legend_parts = []

    if has_discrimination:
        legend_parts.append(
            """
            <span class="integrated-quality-legend-item">
              <span class="integrated-quality-key auroc"></span>
              AUROC
            </span>
            """
        )
        legend_parts.append(
            """
            <span class="integrated-quality-legend-item">
              <span class="integrated-quality-key cindex"></span>
              C-index
            </span>
            """
        )

    if has_r2:
        legend_parts.append(
            """
            <span class="integrated-quality-legend-item">
              thin translucent bar = standard R²
            </span>
            """
        )

    legend_parts.append(
        """
        <span class="integrated-quality-legend-item">
          color = development publication
        </span>
        """
    )

    legend_parts.append(
        f"""
        <span class="integrated-quality-legend-item">
          {n_discrimination_models}/{n_models} models with discrimination ·
          {n_r2_models}/{n_models} with standard R²
        </span>
        """
    )

    title_note_parts = []

    if has_discrimination:
        title_note_parts.append(
            "points = AUROC/C-index"
        )

    if has_r2:
        title_note_parts.append(
            "bars = standard R²"
        )

    title_note = " · ".join(
        title_note_parts
    )

    return f"""
    <div class="integrated-quality-scatter">
      <div class="integrated-quality-heading">
        <span class="integrated-quality-title">
          Model quality
        </span>
        <span class="integrated-quality-note">
          x = your PGS percentile · {html.escape(title_note)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div class="integrated-quality-track"
           aria-label="PGS model quality by user percentile">
        {''.join(grid_html)}
        {r2_axis_html}
        {''.join(mark_html)}
      </div>

      <div class="integrated-quality-legend">
        {''.join(legend_parts)}
      </div>
    </div>
    """




def make_percentile_bar(primary_percentile, models_df, fill_class):
    if use_distribution_percentile_view(models_df):
        return make_percentile_distribution_view(models_df, fill_class)

    primary_pct = clamp_percentile(primary_percentile)
    values = percentile_values(models_df)

    if values.empty:
        low = primary_pct
        high = primary_pct
    else:
        low = clamp_percentile(values.min())
        high = clamp_percentile(values.max())

    solid_width = low if len(values) > 1 else primary_pct
    band_left = low
    band_width = max(0.0, high - low)

    uncertainty_html = ""
    if len(values) > 1 and band_width > 0:
        uncertainty_html = (
            f'<div class="percentile-uncertainty {fill_class}" '
            f'title="Model disagreement range" '
            f'style="left: {band_left:.1f}%; width: {band_width:.1f}%"></div>'
        )

    jitter_points, _ = make_percentile_jitter_points(models_df)
    jitter_class = " has-jitter" if len(values) > 1 else ""

    consensus_label = "Consensus area" if len(values) > 1 else "Predicted percentile range"

    return f"""
    <div class="percentile-track{jitter_class}" aria-label="Percentile bar">
      <div class="percentile-solid {fill_class}" title="{consensus_label}" style="width: {solid_width:.1f}%"></div>
      {uncertainty_html}
      {jitter_points}
      <div class="percentile-marker" title="Best Model Prediction: {fmt_percentile(primary_pct)}" style="left: {primary_pct:.1f}%"></div>
    </div>
    {percentile_axis_labels()}
    """


def mean_numeric(models_df, col):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty or col not in models_df.columns:
        return np.nan
    return pd.to_numeric(models_df[col], errors="coerce").mean()


def mean_variant_match_pct(models_df):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty or "percent_variants_matched" not in models_df.columns:
        return np.nan
    values = pd.to_numeric(models_df["percent_variants_matched"], errors="coerce").apply(variant_match_percent_value)
    return values.mean()

def card_discrimination_summary(models_df):
    """Return the card-level mean validation discrimination.

    Each retained PGS contributes equally:
      1. its ancestry-matched PPM discrimination values are averaged;
      2. those PGS-level means are averaged across the trait card.

    This prevents a PGS with many published PPM endpoints from dominating the
    card simply because it has been evaluated more often.
    """
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return (None, np.nan, 0, 0)

    values = pd.to_numeric(
        models_df["discrimination_value"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).dropna()

    contributing = models_df[
        pd.to_numeric(
            models_df["discrimination_value"],
            errors="coerce",
        ).notna()
    ]

    if values.empty:
        return (None, np.nan, 0, 0)

    metric_labels = (
        contributing["discrimination_metric"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .tolist()
    )

    has_auroc = any("AUROC" in label for label in metric_labels)
    has_concordance = any(
        "concordance" in label.lower()
        for label in metric_labels
    )

    if has_auroc and not has_concordance:
        label = "Mean AUROC"
    elif has_concordance and not has_auroc:
        label = "Mean concordance statistic"
    else:
        label = "Mean AUROC / concordance"

    n_ppm_values = int(
        pd.to_numeric(
            contributing["n_discrimination_ppms"],
            errors="coerce",
        )
        .fillna(0)
        .sum()
    )

    return (
        label,
        float(values.mean()),
        int(len(values)),
        n_ppm_values,
    )


def formatted_pgs_summary_metric(row):
    if row is None:
        return None

    value = row.get("discrimination_value", np.nan)
    label = row.get("discrimination_metric", None)

    if label is None or pd.isna(value):
        return None

    compact_label = (
        str(label)
        .replace("Mean concordance statistic", "Mean C-index")
        .replace("Mean AUROC / concordance", "Mean AUROC/C-index")
    )
    return f"{compact_label} {float(value):.2f}"


def metric_rating(metric_name, value):
    """Return a four-level qualitative rating for selected validation metrics."""
    if value is None or pd.isna(value):
        return None

    value = float(value)

    if metric_name in {"auroc", "discrimination"}:
        if value < 0.60:
            return ("Low", "bad")
        if value < 0.70:
            return ("Moderate", "acceptable")
        if value < 0.80:
            return ("High", "good")
        return ("Very high", "phenomenal")

    if metric_name == "variant_match":
        value = variant_match_percent_value(value)
        if pd.isna(value):
            return None
        if value < 70:
            return ("Low", "bad")
        if value < 80:
            return ("Moderate", "acceptable")
        if value < 95:
            return ("High", "good")
        return ("Very high", "phenomenal")

    return None

def make_header_evidence_orbs(
    all_models,
    odds_ppms,
    hazard_ppms,
    all_ppms,
):
    """Evidence summary: percentile scores plus independently routed evaluations."""
    n_scores = (
        int(
            all_models["pgs_id"]
            .dropna()
            .astype(str)
            .nunique()
        )
        if (
            all_models is not None
            and not all_models.empty
            and "pgs_id" in all_models.columns
        )
        else 0
    )

    evaluation_ppms = (
        all_ppms.drop_duplicates(
            subset=["pgs_id", "ppm_id"],
            keep="first",
        ).copy()
        if all_ppms is not None and not all_ppms.empty
        else pd.DataFrame()
    )

    n_evidence = (
        int(evaluation_ppms["ppm_id"].dropna().astype(str).nunique())
        if not evaluation_ppms.empty
        else 0
    )
    n_cohorts = (
        count_unique_cohorts(evaluation_ppms)
        if not evaluation_ppms.empty
        else 0
    )
    n_publications = (
        count_unique_publications(evaluation_ppms)
        if not evaluation_ppms.empty
        else 0
    )

    orb_specs = [
        (
            "scores",
            n_scores,
            "Scores",
            f"{n_scores} retained PGS scores contribute to the percentile",
        ),
        (
            "effects",
            n_evidence,
            "Evidence",
            f"{n_evidence} outcome-routed performance records",
        ),
        (
            "cohorts",
            n_cohorts,
            "Cohorts",
            f"{n_cohorts} unique cohorts in routed evidence",
        ),
        (
            "publications",
            n_publications,
            "Publications",
            f"{n_publications} publications in routed evidence",
        ),
    ]

    items = []

    for icon_name, value, label, tooltip in orb_specs:
        items.append(
            f"""
            <div class="header-evidence-item"
                 title="{html.escape(str(tooltip))}"
                 aria-label="{html.escape(str(tooltip))}">
              <div class="header-evidence-orb">
                <div class="header-evidence-icon">
                  {header_evidence_icon(icon_name)}
                </div>
                <div class="header-evidence-value">{value}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="header-evidence-label">
                {html.escape(label)}
              </div>
            </div>
            """
        )

    return f"""
    <div class="header-evidence-orbs"
         aria-label="Score and routed validation evidence summary">
      {''.join(items)}
    </div>
    """


def record_display_context(record):
    """Return percentile, risk, agreement, and report-order context for one card."""
    primary = record["primary"]
    all_models = record["all_models"]

    percentile = primary["percentile_norm2"]
    distribution_stats = percentile_distribution_stats(all_models)
    show_distribution_view = use_distribution_percentile_view(all_models)

    display_percentile = display_percentile_for_column(
        primary,
        all_models,
        "percentile_norm2",
    )
    norm1_percentile = display_percentile_for_column(
        primary,
        all_models,
        "percentile_norm1",
    )
    most_similar_percentile = display_percentile_for_column(
        primary,
        all_models,
        "percentile_most_similar_pop",
    )

    risk_label, risk_class, fill_class = risk_level(display_percentile)
    agreement = model_agreement_stats(all_models)
    agreement_status = (
        agreement["status"]
        if agreement is not None
        else "Not assessable"
    )

    n_models = int(len(all_models))
    is_single = n_models <= 1

    moderate_or_better = agreement_status in {
        "Very high",
        "High",
        "Moderate",
    }

    if is_single:
        section = "single"
    elif moderate_or_better:
        section = "multi_supported"
    else:
        section = "low_agreement"

    return {
        "display_percentile": float(display_percentile),
        "norm1_percentile": norm1_percentile,
        "most_similar_percentile": most_similar_percentile,
        "distribution_stats": distribution_stats,
        "show_distribution_view": show_distribution_view,
        "risk_label": risk_label,
        "risk_class": risk_class,
        "fill_class": fill_class,
        "agreement": agreement,
        "agreement_status": agreement_status,
        "section": section,
    }


def trait_story_sentence(risk_label, agreement_status):
    """Return one concise, non-diagnostic interpretation sentence."""
    strong_agreement = agreement_status in {
        "Very high",
        "High",
        "Moderate",
    }

    if agreement_status == "Not assessable":
        if risk_label in {"Increased", "Highly Increased"}:
            return (
                "This PGS places you toward the higher end of the population distribution, "
                "but cross-model agreement cannot be assessed from a single retained score."
            )
        if risk_label in {"Lowered", "Very low"}:
            return (
                "This PGS places you toward the lower end of the population distribution, "
                "but cross-model agreement cannot be assessed from a single retained score."
            )
        return (
            "This PGS places you within the typical population range, but cross-model "
            "agreement cannot be assessed from a single retained score."
        )

    if risk_label in {"Increased", "Highly Increased"}:
        if strong_agreement:
            return (
                "The available PGS models consistently place you toward the higher end "
                "of the population distribution."
            )
        return (
            "Some PGS models suggest elevated genetic predisposition, but the models "
            "disagree about its magnitude."
        )

    if risk_label == "Normal":
        if strong_agreement:
            return (
                "The available PGS models consistently place you within the typical "
                "population range."
            )
        return (
            "The overall result falls within the typical population range, although "
            "individual PGS models vary considerably."
        )

    if strong_agreement:
        return (
            "The available PGS models consistently place you toward the lower end "
            "of the population distribution."
        )

    return (
        "Several PGS models suggest a lower percentile, but the models disagree "
        "about the magnitude."
    )



def make_trait_context_box(
    trait,
    interpretation,
    all_models,
    all_ppms,
):
    """Short explanation of the percentile score and independently routed evidence."""
    n_scores = (
        int(
            all_models["pgs_id"]
            .dropna()
            .astype(str)
            .nunique()
        )
        if all_models is not None and not all_models.empty
        else 0
    )

    n_evidence = (
        int(all_ppms["ppm_id"].dropna().astype(str).nunique())
        if all_ppms is not None and not all_ppms.empty
        else 0
    )

    description = (
        f"{trait} is the condition or phenotype represented by this card. "
        f"{n_scores} retained polygenic {plural_word(n_scores, 'score')} "
        "contribute to the percentile result. "
        f"{n_evidence} published performance "
        f"{plural_word(n_evidence, 'record')} are routed here according to the "
        "outcome they actually evaluated; evidence from unrelated outcomes is "
        "not combined with this card."
    )

    return f"""
    <div class="pgs-context-box">
      <div class="pgs-context-heading">About this result</div>
      <div class="pgs-context-result">
        {html.escape(str(interpretation))}
      </div>
      <div class="pgs-context-description">
        {html.escape(description)}
      </div>
    </div>
    """

    <div class="pgs-summary-transition"

        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"
             focusable="false"
             aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"></path>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
    """



def make_agreement_callout(card_section):
    """Show the caution tag on every card in the low-agreement section."""
    if card_section != "low_agreement":
        return ""

    return """
    <div class="agreement-callout">
      Models disagree substantially — interpret this result cautiously.
    </div>
    """


def plural_word(n, singular, plural=None):
    return singular if n == 1 else (plural or singular + "s")


def make_trait_card(record):
    primary = record["primary"]
    odds_models = record["odds_models"]
    hazard_models = record["hazard_models"]
    all_models = record["all_models"]
    all_ppms = record["all_ppms"]
    restricted_ppms = record.get("restricted_ppms", pd.DataFrame())
    score_quality_ppms = record.get(
        "score_quality_ppms",
        pd.DataFrame(),
    )

    percentile = primary["percentile_norm2"]
    context = record_display_context(record)
    distribution_stats = context["distribution_stats"]
    show_distribution_view = context["show_distribution_view"]
    display_percentile = context["display_percentile"]
    norm1_percentile = context["norm1_percentile"]
    most_similar_percentile = context["most_similar_percentile"]
    risk_label = context["risk_label"]
    risk_class = context["risk_class"]
    fill_class = context["fill_class"]
    agreement_status = context["agreement_status"]
    card_section = context["section"]

    quality_panel = make_model_quality_panel(
        all_models,
        score_quality_ppms,
    )
    percentile_bar = make_percentile_bar(
        percentile,
        all_models,
        fill_class,
    )
    consensus_box = make_consensus_box(
        all_models,
        percentile,
    )
    interpretation = trait_story_sentence(risk_label, agreement_status)
    agreement_callout = make_agreement_callout(card_section)

    trait = safe_text(primary["reported_trait"])
    context_box = make_trait_context_box(
        trait,
        interpretation,
        all_models,
        all_ppms,
    )
    summary_transition = make_summary_transition_marker()

    outcome_evidence_html = make_outcome_evidence_sections(
        all_ppms
    )
    restricted_evidence_html = make_restricted_evidence_note(
        restricted_ppms
    )

    if show_distribution_view:
        variant_match_value = fmt_variant_match_pct(mean_variant_match_pct(all_models))
        variant_match_caption = f"Mean across {len(all_models)} retained models"
    else:
        variant_match_value = fmt_variant_match_pct(primary.get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan))
        variant_match_caption = (
            f"{fmt_int(primary.get('n_variants_matched', np.nan))} variants matched in primary model"
            if fmt_int(primary.get("n_variants_matched", np.nan))
            else "Primary model"
        )

    variant_rating = metric_rating(
        "variant_match",
        mean_variant_match_pct(all_models) if show_distribution_view else primary.get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan),
    )

    metric_boxes = ""
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box(
        "Variant match",
        variant_match_value,
        variant_match_caption,
        status=variant_rating,
    )

    model_agreement = make_model_agreement(all_models)
    header_evidence_orbs = make_header_evidence_orbs(
        all_models,
        odds_models,
        hazard_models,
        all_ppms,
    )

    models_dropdown = make_models_dropdown(all_models, all_ppms)

    return f"""
    <article class="pgs-card card-risk-{risk_class}">
      <div class="pgs-card-header">
        <div class="pgs-header-left">
          <div class="pgs-title-row">
            <h3 class="pgs-title">{trait}</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="pgs-header-right">
          {header_evidence_orbs}
        </div>

        <div class="pgs-percentile-hero"
             aria-label="Ancestry-standardized percentile {fmt_percentile(display_percentile)}">
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-values">
            <div
              class="pgs-percentile-secondary"
              title="Mean-adjusted percentile"
            >
              <div class="pgs-percentile-secondary-label">Mean-adjusted</div>
              <div class="pgs-percentile-secondary-value">
                {fmt_percentile(norm1_percentile)}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="pgs-percentile-primary">
              <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-label">
                {"Median percentile" if show_distribution_view else "Percentile"}
                · Ancestry-standardized
              </div>
              <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-value">
                {fmt_percentile(display_percentile)}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div
              class="pgs-percentile-secondary"
              title="Closest-population ancestry-matched percentile"
            >
              <div class="pgs-percentile-secondary-label">
                Closest ancestry
              </div>
              <div class="pgs-percentile-secondary-value">
                {fmt_percentile(most_similar_percentile)}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-badge">
            <div class="risk-badge risk-{risk_class}">{risk_label}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-caption">
            Ancestry-standardized percentile is used for report ranking, model agreement, and risk category.
          </div>
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-rule"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {context_box}
      {agreement_callout}
      {summary_transition}

      <section class="pgs-detailed-section">
        <div class="card-details-divider">
          <div class="card-details-divider-title">Detailed results</div>
          {model_agreement}
        </div>

        <div class="percentile-block">
          <div class="percentile-topline">
            <div class="percentile-label">{"Median percentile" if show_distribution_view else "Percentile"} · Ancestry-standardized</div>
            <div class="percentile-value">{fmt_percentile(display_percentile)}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="percentile-quality-composite">
            {quality_panel}
            {
                '<div class="percentile-quality-divider"></div>'
                if quality_panel
                else ''
            }
            {percentile_bar}
          </div>
          {consensus_box}
        </div>

        {outcome_evidence_html}
        {restricted_evidence_html}

        <div class="metric-grid">
          {metric_boxes}
        </div>

        <div class="metadata-panel">
          {models_dropdown}
        </div>
      </section>
    </article>
    """

def sort_records_by_percentile(records):
    """Order cards from highest displayed percentile to lowest."""
    return sorted(
        records,
        key=lambda record: (
            -record_display_context(record)["display_percentile"],
            str(record["reported_trait"]).lower(),
        ),
    )


def section_emblem_svg(section_class):
    """Return a clean line icon for each result section."""
    icons = {
        "standout": """
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
  <path d="M4 16h16"></path>
  <path d="M7 12h10"></path>
  <path d="M10 8h4"></path>
  <path d="M12 5v14"></path>
</svg>
""",
        "other": """
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
  <rect x="6.5" y="4.5" width="11" height="15" rx="2.2"></rect>
  <path d="M9 9h6"></path>
  <path d="M9 13h6"></path>
</svg>
""",
        "caution": """
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
  <path d="M12 4.5l8 14H4z"></path>
  <path d="M12 9v4.8"></path>
  <path d="M12 17.2h.01"></path>
</svg>
""",
    }

    return icons.get(section_class, icons["other"])


def compact_result_evidence(record):
    """Small evidence summary for a typical-range result."""
    all_models = record["all_models"]
    all_ppms = record["all_ppms"]

    if all_models is None or all_models.empty:
        n_scores = 0
        retained_score_ids = set()
    else:
        retained_score_ids = {
            str(value).strip()
            for value in all_models["pgs_id"].dropna()
            if str(value).strip()
        }
        n_scores = len(retained_score_ids)

    evaluation_ppms = (
        all_ppms.copy()
        if all_ppms is not None
        else pd.DataFrame()
    )

    if (
        not evaluation_ppms.empty
        and "primary_model_eligible" in evaluation_ppms.columns
    ):
        evaluation_ppms = evaluation_ppms[
            evaluation_ppms["primary_model_eligible"].fillna(False)
        ].copy()

    if (
        not evaluation_ppms.empty
        and "ppm_id" in evaluation_ppms.columns
    ):
        dedupe_columns = ["ppm_id"]
        if "pgs_id" in evaluation_ppms.columns:
            dedupe_columns = ["pgs_id", "ppm_id"]

        evaluation_ppms = evaluation_ppms.drop_duplicates(
            subset=dedupe_columns,
            keep="first",
        )

    n_publications = (
        count_unique_publications(evaluation_ppms)
        if not evaluation_ppms.empty
        else 0
    )

    agreement = model_agreement_stats(all_models)
    if agreement is None or agreement["n"] <= 1:
        agreement_label = "Single PGS"
    else:
        agreement_label = agreement["status"]

    variant_match = mean_variant_match_pct(all_models)

    return {
        "n_scores": n_scores,
        "n_publications": n_publications,
        "agreement": agreement_label,
        "variant_match": variant_match,
        "pgs_ids": sorted(retained_score_ids),
    }


def make_compact_result_row(record):
    """Compact display for a 20th-79th percentile result."""
    context = record_display_context(record)
    primary = record["primary"]
    evidence = compact_result_evidence(record)

    trait = safe_text(primary["reported_trait"])
    percentile = context["display_percentile"]

    pgs_title = (
        " · ".join(evidence["pgs_ids"])
        if evidence["pgs_ids"]
        else "No retained PGS identifier"
    )

    meta_items = [
        f'{evidence["n_scores"]} {plural_word(evidence["n_scores"], "score")}',
        html.escape(evidence["agreement"]),
        (
            f'{evidence["n_publications"]} '
            f'{plural_word(evidence["n_publications"], "publication")}'
        ),
    ]

    variant_match = evidence["variant_match"]
    if variant_match is not None and not pd.isna(variant_match):
        meta_items.append(
            f'{float(variant_match):.0f}% mean variant match'
        )

    return f"""
    <div
      class="compact-result-row"
      title="{html.escape(pgs_title)}"
    >
      <div class="compact-result-main">
        <div class="compact-result-title">
          {trait}
        </div>
        <div class="compact-result-meta">
          {'<span>·</span>'.join(
              f'<span>{item}</span>'
              for item in meta_items
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="compact-result-percentile">
        {fmt_percentile(percentile)}
        <span>Percentile</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    """


def make_typical_technical_summary(records):
    """One compact technical table for typical-range cards in a panel.

    This intentionally replaces the two large repeated dropdown tables that
    would otherwise be embedded in every ordinary result card.
    """
    if not records:
        return ""

    rows = []

    for record in sorted(
        records,
        key=lambda item: str(
            item["primary"]["reported_trait"]
        ).casefold(),
    ):
        context = record_display_context(record)
        evidence = compact_result_evidence(record)
        trait = safe_text(
            record["primary"]["reported_trait"]
        )

        rows.append(
            f"""
            <tr>
              <td>{trait}</td>
              <td>{fmt_percentile(context["display_percentile"])}</td>
              <td>{evidence["n_scores"]}</td>
              <td>{html.escape(evidence["agreement"])}</td>
              <td>{evidence["n_publications"]}</td>
              <td>{fmt_variant_match_pct(evidence["variant_match"])}</td>
              <td>{html.escape(", ".join(evidence["pgs_ids"]))}</td>
            </tr>
            """
        )

    return f"""
    <details class="typical-technical-details">
      <summary>
        Technical summary for typical-range results
      </summary>
      <div class="typical-technical-table-wrap">
        <table class="typical-technical-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Trait</th>
              <th>Percentile</th>
              <th>Scores</th>
              <th>Agreement</th>
              <th>Publications</th>
              <th>Mean variant match</th>
              <th>PGS IDs</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {''.join(rows)}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </details>
    """


def render_full_result_group(
    title,
    subtitle,
    records,
    group_class,
    low_first=False,
):
    """Render full cards only for noteworthy percentile results."""
    if not records:
        return ""

    if low_first:
        ordered_records = sorted(
            records,
            key=lambda record: (
                record_display_context(record)["display_percentile"],
                str(record["reported_trait"]).casefold(),
            ),
        )
    else:
        ordered_records = sort_records_by_percentile(records)

    cards_html = "\n".join(
        f'<div class="card-stack-item">{make_trait_card(record)}</div>'
        for record in ordered_records
    )

    return f"""
    <section class="panel-result-group panel-result-group-{group_class}">
      <div class="panel-result-group-heading">
        <div>
          <div class="panel-result-group-kicker">
            Noteworthy results
          </div>
          <div class="panel-result-group-title">
            {html.escape(title)}
          </div>
          <div class="panel-result-group-description">
            {html.escape(subtitle)}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="panel-result-group-count">
          {len(records)} {plural_word(len(records), "trait")}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="pgs-card-grid">
        {cards_html}
      </div>
    </section>
    """


def render_typical_results(records):
    """Render ordinary 20th-79th percentile results compactly."""
    if not records:
        return ""

    ordered_records = sorted(
        records,
        key=lambda record: str(
            record["reported_trait"]
        ).casefold(),
    )

    rows_html = "".join(
        make_compact_result_row(record)
        for record in ordered_records
    )

    technical_summary = make_typical_technical_summary(
        ordered_records
    )

    return f"""
    <details class="typical-results-details">
      <summary>
        <div>
          <div class="typical-results-summary-title">
            Typical-range results
          </div>
          <span class="typical-results-summary-subtitle">
            Results from the 20th through 79th percentile are summarized
            compactly to keep the report focused.
          </span>
        </div>

        <span class="typical-results-count">
          {len(records)} {plural_word(len(records), "trait")}
        </span>

        <span
          class="typical-results-chevron"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"></path>
          </svg>
        </span>
      </summary>

      <div class="typical-results-grid">
        {rows_html}
      </div>

      {technical_summary}
    </details>
    """

def category_description(panel_name):
    db_description = CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS_DB.get(panel_name, "")
    if db_description:
        return db_description

    return CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS.get(
        panel_name,
        (
            "This section groups related health traits from the SNPster report "
            "library. Each result should be interpreted according to its specific "
            "phenotype and supporting evidence."
        ),
    )


def make_category_profile_summary(panel_name, records):
    """Category-specific version of 'Your profile at a glance'."""
    if not records:
        return """
        <section class="results-summary-shell category-results-summary">
          <div class="results-summary-heading">
            <div>
              <div class="results-summary-kicker">Category Summary</div>
              <div class="results-summary-title">Your profile at a glance</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="panel-empty-state">
            No retained results are available for this category.
          </div>
        </section>
        """

    contexts = [
        (record, record_display_context(record))
        for record in records
    ]

    percentiles = pd.Series(
        [
            context["display_percentile"]
            for _, context in contexts
            if (
                context["display_percentile"] is not None
                and not pd.isna(context["display_percentile"])
            )
        ],
        dtype="float64",
    ).dropna()

    profile_index = (
        50.0
        if percentiles.empty
        else float(percentiles.mean())
    )
    profile_index = max(0.0, min(100.0, profile_index))

    high_count = sum(
        (
            context["display_percentile"] is not None
            and not pd.isna(context["display_percentile"])
            and float(context["display_percentile"]) >= 80
        )
        for _, context in contexts
    )
    low_count = sum(
        (
            context["display_percentile"] is not None
            and not pd.isna(context["display_percentile"])
            and float(context["display_percentile"]) < 20
        )
        for _, context in contexts
    )
    typical_count = len(records) - high_count - low_count
    low_agreement_count = sum(
        context["section"] == "low_agreement"
        for _, context in contexts
    )

    spectrum_points = []

    for record, context in contexts:
        percentile = context["display_percentile"]
        if percentile is None or pd.isna(percentile):
            continue

        percentile = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(percentile)))
        trait = str(record["reported_trait"])
        risk_label, risk_class, _ = risk_level(percentile)

        if context["section"] == "multi_supported":
            evidence_class = "supported"
            evidence_label = "Multi-PGS · Moderate-or-better agreement"
        elif context["section"] == "single":
            evidence_class = "single"
            evidence_label = "Single PGS"
        else:
            evidence_class = "low-agreement"
            evidence_label = "Multi-PGS · Low or Very low agreement"

        spectrum_points.append({
            "trait": trait,
            "percentile": percentile,
            "risk_label": risk_label,
            "risk_class": risk_class,
            "agreement_status": context["agreement_status"],
            "evidence_class": evidence_class,
            "evidence_label": evidence_label,
        })

    n_lanes = 5
    min_horizontal_gap = 3.2
    lane_last_percentile = [-999.0] * n_lanes

    for point in sorted(
        spectrum_points,
        key=lambda item: (
            item["percentile"],
            item["trait"].casefold(),
        ),
    ):
        available_lanes = [
            lane
            for lane in range(n_lanes)
            if (
                point["percentile"]
                - lane_last_percentile[lane]
                >= min_horizontal_gap
            )
        ]

        if available_lanes:
            lane = available_lanes[0]
        else:
            lane = min(
                range(n_lanes),
                key=lambda index: lane_last_percentile[index],
            )

        point["lane"] = lane
        lane_last_percentile[lane] = point["percentile"]

    point_html = []

    for point in spectrum_points:
        display_left = max(0.8, min(99.2, point["percentile"]))
        top = 11 + point["lane"] * 15

        tooltip = (
            f"{point['trait']} · "
            f"{fmt_percentile(point['percentile'])} percentile · "
            f"{point['risk_label']} · {point['evidence_label']} · "
            f"Model agreement: {point['agreement_status']}"
        )

        point_html.append(
            f'<span class="profile-spectrum-point '
            f'profile-spectrum-point-{html.escape(point["evidence_class"])} '
            f'profile-spectrum-risk-{html.escape(point["risk_class"])}" '
            f'title="{html.escape(tooltip)}" '
            f'style="left: {display_left:.2f}%; top: {top}px;"></span>'
        )

    orb_html = f"""
    <div class="panel-index-summary">
      <div
        class="panel-index-orb"
        title="Equal-trait mean percentile in this category: {profile_index:.1f}"
      >
        <div class="panel-index-orb-value">{profile_index:.0f}</div>
        <div class="panel-index-orb-scale">of 100</div>
      </div>
      <div class="panel-index-copy">
        <div class="panel-index-label">Category profile index</div>
        <div class="panel-index-description">
          Equal-trait mean of displayed percentiles in this category.
          This is descriptive, not a combined clinical-risk score.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    """

    spectrum_html = f"""
    <div class="profile-spectrum">
      <div class="profile-spectrum-header">
        <div>
          <div class="profile-spectrum-title">
            Your percentile profile in {html.escape(panel_name)}
          </div>
          <div class="profile-spectrum-subtitle">
            Each marker is one trait. Hover to see its percentile and model agreement.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="profile-spectrum-counts">
          <span class="profile-spectrum-count"><strong>{low_count}</strong> lower</span>
          <span class="profile-spectrum-count"><strong>{typical_count}</strong> typical</span>
          <span class="profile-spectrum-count"><strong>{high_count}</strong> higher</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        class="profile-spectrum-plot"
        aria-label="Category trait percentiles from 0 to 100"
      >
        <div class="profile-spectrum-baseline"></div>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-boundary" style="left: 5%;"></span>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-boundary" style="left: 20%;"></span>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-boundary" style="left: 80%;"></span>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-boundary" style="left: 95%;"></span>
        {''.join(point_html)}
      </div>

      <div class="profile-spectrum-axis">
        <span class="profile-spectrum-axis-label edge-left" style="left: 0%;">0</span>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-axis-label" style="left: 20%;">20</span>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-axis-label" style="left: 50%;">50</span>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-axis-label" style="left: 80%;">80</span>
        <span class="profile-spectrum-axis-label edge-right" style="left: 100%;">100</span>
      </div>

      <div class="profile-spectrum-bands">
        <div class="profile-spectrum-band">Very low</div>
        <div class="profile-spectrum-band">Lowered</div>
        <div class="profile-spectrum-band">Typical</div>
        <div class="profile-spectrum-band">Increased</div>
        <div class="profile-spectrum-band">Highly increased</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    """

    return f"""
    <section class="results-summary-shell category-results-summary">
      <div class="results-summary-heading">
        <div>
          <div class="results-summary-kicker">Category Summary</div>
          <div class="results-summary-title">Your profile at a glance</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {orb_html}
      {spectrum_html}

      <div class="category-overview-stats">
        <div class="category-overview-stat">
          <strong>{high_count}</strong>
          <span>Higher · ≥80</span>
        </div>
        <div class="category-overview-stat">
          <strong>{typical_count}</strong>
          <span>Typical · 20–79</span>
        </div>
        <div class="category-overview-stat">
          <strong>{low_count}</strong>
          <span>Lower · &lt;20</span>
        </div>
        <div class="category-overview-stat">
          <strong>{low_agreement_count}</strong>
          <span>Low model agreement</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    """


def render_panel_report_section(panel_name, records):
    """Render one report tab from the curated consumer category mapping."""
    metadata = panel_metadata[panel_name]
    description = category_description(panel_name)
    category_overview_html = make_category_profile_summary(
        panel_name,
        records,
    )

    high_records = []
    low_records = []
    typical_records = []

    for record in records:
        percentile = record_display_context(
            record
        )["display_percentile"]

        if percentile is None or pd.isna(percentile):
            typical_records.append(record)
            continue

        percentile = float(percentile)

        if percentile >= 80:
            high_records.append(record)
        elif percentile < 20:
            low_records.append(record)
        else:
            typical_records.append(record)

    if records:
        high_html = render_full_result_group(
            "Higher-percentile results",
            (
                "Results at or above the 80th percentile. These receive full "
                "cards because they are the most likely to warrant closer review."
            ),
            high_records,
            "high",
            low_first=False,
        )

        low_html = render_full_result_group(
            "Lower-percentile results",
            (
                "Results below the 20th percentile. These receive full cards so "
                "lower inherited predisposition remains as visible as higher results."
            ),
            low_records,
            "low",
            low_first=True,
        )

        typical_html = render_typical_results(
            typical_records
        )

        if not high_html and not low_html:
            noteworthy_html = """
            <div class="panel-empty-state">
              No results in this section fall outside the 20th–79th
              percentile range.
            </div>
            """
        else:
            noteworthy_html = high_html + low_html

        body_html = noteworthy_html + typical_html
    else:
        body_html = f"""
        <div class="panel-empty-state">
          No ancestry-matched scores with at least
          {MIN_PRIMARY_VARIANT_MATCH_PCT:.0f}% matched variants were retained
          for this section.
        </div>
        """

    return f"""
    <section
      class="panel-report-section report-tab-panel"
      data-report-tab="{html.escape(metadata['anchor'])}"
      id="{html.escape(metadata['anchor'])}"
      hidden
      style="
        --panel-accent: {metadata['accent']};
        --panel-soft: {metadata['soft']};
        --panel-border: {metadata['border']};
        --section-divider-accent: {metadata['divider']};
      "
    >
      <div class="panel-section-header panel-section-inner">
          <div class="panel-section-copy">
            <div class="panel-section-kicker">
              Health section {metadata['index']:02d}
            </div>
            <h2 class="panel-section-title">
              {html.escape(panel_name)}
            </h2>
            <div class="panel-section-subtitle">
              {len(records)} evaluated {plural_word(len(records), "trait")} in this health area.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="panel-section-stats">
            <div class="panel-section-stat">
              <strong>{metadata['trait_count']}</strong>
              <span>Traits</span>
            </div>
            <div class="panel-section-stat panel-section-stat-high">
              <strong>{metadata['high_count']}</strong>
              <span>High</span>
            </div>
            <div class="panel-section-stat panel-section-stat-low">
              <strong>{metadata['low_count']}</strong>
              <span>Low</span>
            </div>
          </div>

      </div>

      <div class="panel-section-content panel-section-inner">
        <div class="category-intro">
          <div class="category-intro-kicker">About this section</div>
          <div class="category-intro-text">
            {html.escape(description)}
          </div>
        </div>

        {category_overview_html}

        {body_html}
      </div>
    </section>
    """


# Render each health section as a separate Jupyter HTML output.
# Sections are collapsed by default and ordinary 20th-79th percentile results
# use compact rows, keeping both the visual report and each Quarto output unit
# substantially smaller than the original all-full-card design.
for panel_name in all_report_section_names:
    panel_html = render_panel_report_section(
        panel_name,
        panel_records_by_name.get(panel_name, []),
    )
    display(HTML(panel_html))
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const tabButtons = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-report-tab-target]")
  );

  const tabPanels = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-report-tab]")
  );

  const categoryKeys = new Set(
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        ".panel-report-section[data-report-tab]"
      )
    ).map(function (panel) {
      return panel.dataset.reportTab;
    })
  );

  function tabForHash() {
    const rawHash = window.location.hash;

    if (!rawHash || rawHash.length < 2) {
      return "intro";
    }

    const hash = decodeURIComponent(rawHash.slice(1));

    if (hash === "intro") {
      return "intro";
    }

    if (categoryKeys.has(hash)) {
      return hash;
    }

    const target = document.getElementById(hash);

    if (target) {
      const owningPanel = target.closest("[data-report-tab]");

      if (owningPanel && owningPanel.dataset.reportTab) {
        return owningPanel.dataset.reportTab;
      }
    }

    return "intro";
  }

  function scrollTargetForTab(tabKey) {
    if (tabKey === "intro") {
      return document.getElementById("report-introduction");
    }

    return document.getElementById(tabKey);
  }

  function activateTab(
    tabKey,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const updateHash = options.updateHash !== false;
    const shouldScroll = options.scroll === true;

    const validTab = (
      tabKey === "intro" ||
      categoryKeys.has(tabKey)
    )
      ? tabKey
      : "intro";

    tabPanels.forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.hidden = panel.dataset.reportTab !== validTab;
    });

    tabButtons.forEach(function (button) {
      const isActive = (
        button.dataset.reportTabTarget === validTab
      );

      button.classList.toggle("is-active", isActive);
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-selected",
        isActive ? "true" : "false"
      );
    });

    document.documentElement.dataset.activeReportTab = validTab;

    if (updateHash) {
      const newHash = (
        validTab === "intro"
          ? "#intro"
          : "#" + encodeURIComponent(validTab)
      );

      if (window.location.hash !== newHash) {
        history.pushState(null, "", newHash);
      }
    }

    if (shouldScroll) {
      const target = scrollTargetForTab(validTab);

      if (target) {
        target.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: "smooth",
          block: "start"
        });
      }
    }
  }

  tabButtons.forEach(function (button) {
    button.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      const tabKey = button.dataset.reportTabTarget;

      if (!tabKey) return;

      event.preventDefault();

      activateTab(tabKey, {
        updateHash: true,
        scroll: true
      });
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function () {
    activateTab(
      tabForHash(),
      {
        updateHash: false,
        scroll: false
      }
    );
  });

  // Open all collapsible technical/typical content for printing, then restore
  // the user's screen state afterwards.
  let printOpenState = [];

  window.addEventListener("beforeprint", function () {
    printOpenState = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll("details")
    ).map(function (details) {
      return [details, details.open];
    });

    printOpenState.forEach(function (item) {
      item[0].open = true;
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener("afterprint", function () {
    printOpenState.forEach(function (item) {
      item[0].open = item[1];
    });
  });

  activateTab(
    tabForHash(),
    {
      updateHash: false,
      scroll: false
    }
  );
});
</script>
```

```{=html}
<details
  id="report-methodology"
  class="method-note method-details report-tab-panel"
  data-report-tab="intro"
>
  <summary>How this report works</summary>
  <div class="method-details-content">
    <p><strong>Combined report scope.</strong> The supplied <code>prsc_id</code> identifies the user's imputation context. The report takes the latest completed result for each PGS across all completed PRS jobs for that imputation. Only PGS IDs present in <code>data_libraries.report_trait_scores</code> generate cards; the report taxonomy tables supply the clean trait label and consolidated category. Ancestry-matched performance records from any variant-QC-passing scored PGS remain available for outcome routing, even when the source PGS itself is not a consumer-facing card.</p>
    <p><strong>Overall profile index.</strong> The whole-report index is the arithmetic mean of the displayed trait percentiles, with every trait receiving equal weight. It is shown as a compact 0–100 reference value and is a descriptive profile summary, not a combined clinical-risk score.</p>
    <p><strong>Ancestry adjustment and validation evidence.</strong> The report separates two related ancestry tasks. First, the displayed genetic percentile is normalized continuously across genetic ancestry. The reader-facing <strong>Mean-adjusted</strong> value corresponds to adjustment of ancestry-related differences in the mean score, while <strong>Ancestry-standardized</strong> additionally adjusts ancestry-related differences in score variance and is the primary report value. This continuous adjustment is especially useful when a person is admixed or does not lie cleanly inside one labeled reference population. Second, validation cohorts are selected from every ancestry component above 20%, with the recorded primary ancestry retained as a fallback. This means a substantially admixed person can retain evaluation evidence from more than one ancestry group. The ESS field can contain several comma-separated ancestry labels, so recognized ancestry tokens are matched rather than requiring the full field to equal one label. The selected cohort identifiers then restrict the performance evaluations considered for each polygenic score. No ancestry adjustment can fully compensate for sparse reference data, so results remain dependent on reference-panel diversity and sample size.</p>
    <p><strong>Evidence labels.</strong> Model agreement and validation-performance badges use an ordered low-to-high scale rather than value-laden terms such as good or bad. These labels describe statistical consistency or discrimination, not whether the user's health result is favorable.</p>
    <p><strong>Card summary text.</strong> Each card currently includes a generic plain-language box that combines the personalized percentile interpretation with a temporary explanation of the trait and the statistics shown in the card. This text is designed to be replaced by curated, database-backed trait descriptions.</p>
    <p><strong>Report presentation.</strong> The interactive HTML report uses one Introduction tab plus one tab for each consolidated consumer health category. Each health tab contains a short category introduction and category-specific “Your profile at a glance” summary; no whole-report percentile spectrum is used because combining hundreds of traits makes the visualization difficult to interpret. Only the selected tab is shown on screen, while printing reveals all sections sequentially. Within each health tab, results at or above the 80th percentile and below the 20th percentile are rendered as full result cards. Results from the 20th through 79th percentile are shown in a compact expandable list with a single technical summary table. This changes presentation only; it does not change percentile calculation.</p>
    <p><strong>Card grouping and evidence routing.</strong> Consumer card membership is explicit rather than inferred at render time: <code>data_libraries.report_score_catalog_v</code> provides the PGS ID, clean customer-facing trait name, and consolidated category. Scores with the same clean trait label in the same category form one card. Percentile, z-score, variant match and model agreement are score-level properties and are represented once per retained PGS. Performance evidence is a separate layer: each ancestry-matched PPM is cleaned and routed by <code>evaluation_target_trait</code>. The PGS that produced a PPM therefore does not determine which clinical card receives that evaluation. The Scores orb counts PGS models contributing to the percentile; Evidence, Cohorts and Publications describe the outcome-routed performance records attached to that card.</p>
    <p><strong>Outcome-routed performance evidence.</strong> Performance records are assigned to cards according to the cleaned <em>evaluation outcome</em>, independently of the reported trait of the PGS that generated the evaluation. Performance records sharing the same curated <code>evaluation_outcome_key</code> are pooled into one outcome row, so estimates from different papers studying the same outcome appear in the same distribution plot. Genuinely different evaluated outcomes remain separate.</p>
    <p><strong>Effect-size semantics.</strong> Dedicated odds ratios and hazard ratios are personalized with <code>ratio^z</code> only when the structured metadata indicates a per-standard-deviation effect, or when no contrary basis is documented. Explicit percentile/quartile/group comparisons are excluded from that transformation and shown only as published group contrasts. Dedicated beta values are displayed separately as beta per SD, with <code>beta × z</code> shown only as an estimated shift in the study-reported outcome units. R², incremental R², partial R², adjusted R², liability R² and pseudo-R² are kept as distinct metric types and are never pooled onto the OR/HR axis.</p>
    <p><strong>Validation discrimination.</strong> AUROC and concordance are optional descriptive evidence rather than score-eligibility requirements. For primary quality display, SNPster uses the v3 curated PGS-quality metric rather than automatically treating a full clinical model as PGS-only performance. A score with no eligible AUROC or concordance can still remain in the report when it has ancestry-matched evaluation evidence and passes variant-match QC.</p>
    <p><strong>Applicability restrictions.</strong> Evaluation records with explicit age, condition, sex, carrier, case-only, high-risk, or other subgroup restrictions are not applied as general personalized evidence. Descriptive cohort age alone does not trigger exclusion. Because the current user profile does not encode enough clinical eligibility context to safely match these restrictions, such records are retained for transparency but excluded from personalized OR/HR/Beta transformations, primary AUROC/C-index quality summaries, and main outcome-evidence aggregation.</p>
    <p><strong>Model selection.</strong> The hard score-level pruning is ancestry relevance plus variant match: PGS models with less than 70% matched variants or missing variant-match data are removed before model agreement, overview figures, or card construction. AUROC and concordance do not determine inclusion. The representative PGS is ranked first by variant match, then by available evaluation sample size, with discrimination used only as a later tie-breaking preference.</p>
    <p><strong>Model families and SNPster weighted effects.</strong> Within each development publication and reported trait, scores with the same non-missing development method receive the same descriptive family ID. For odds- and hazard-based plots only, the SNPster weighted mean uses raw weight <code>(1 / family size) × performance-record AUROC or concordance × variant-match fraction</code>. Percentile summaries remain unweighted.</p>
    <p><strong>Model agreement.</strong> Agreement is calculated from the ancestry-standardized percentiles. For cards with more than four retained percentile values, agreement is classified from IQR width. For cards with two to four values, agreement uses the full minimum-to-maximum distance. Spread below 5 percentile points is Very high agreement, below 10 is High, below 20 is Moderate, 20–25 is Low, and above 25 is Very low. A single retained PGS is Not assessable.</p>
    <p><strong>Distribution display.</strong> Multi-PGS percentile cards use ancestry-standardized percentiles and show the IQR as the translucent band and Tukey whiskers as the skinny colored line. PGS points are colored by development publication, while odds/hazard estimate points are colored by validation publication; the same publication receives the same deterministic color throughout the report. Odds and hazard distributions use the same boxplot-style geometry as the percentile display: the no-change value (0%) is fixed at the exact center, publication-colored estimates are jittered around the central baseline, and the range/IQR is colored by effect direction. R²-family metrics are displayed separately for each evaluated outcome and are never placed on the OR/HR axis.</p>
  </div>
</details>
```

```{=html}
<div
  class="method-note report-tab-panel"
  data-report-tab="intro"
>
  <strong>Important limitations.</strong>
  Polygenic scores estimate inherited genetic predisposition; they are not diagnostic tests.
  AUROC/concordance summaries, odds ratios, and hazard ratios come from ancestry-matched cohort-level performance records and may still not transfer perfectly across age groups, sex, genotyping arrays, imputation pipelines, or more fine-grained ancestry differences.
  The individualized risk-effect calculation uses the user's ancestry-standardized z-score and assumes that the source odds ratio or hazard ratio is reported per standard deviation of the PRS. If the original publication used a different effect unit or comparison group, the transformed percentage may be misleading and should be flagged in your score-selection database.
</div>
```
